title: Existing unapproved prior-day sweep and lagged peer-resilience proposal
findings: This is the project's existing internal proposal, not an externally authored or independently established strategy.
The prior fully completed UTC day low is swept and reclaimed under completed higher-timeframe context and previously lagged BTC/ETH peer features.
Every operational mapping in this implementation request is a research extension. Neither this proposal nor the implementation claims Elliott wave counting, independent novelty or economic edge.
The 2025 historical window is already inspected research context; it is not a pristine prospective test. No market replay is authorized by compilation.

coverage.context: Internal proposal: completed four-hour range and one-hour volatility with lagged peer-beta residual and downside-variance context.
coverage.entry: Internal proposal: a completed 15-minute low crosses the previous UTC day low, then closes above it with positive body, close location and volume gates.
